method: Generated hero per item, reviewed against quarters concepts. Parametric fitted closed parts for rigid manufactured shapes; Hunyuan silhouette guide for boots. Blender native Z-up, front -Y; glTF +Y up, front +Z.
generator: Z-Image-Turbo mflux 4-bit, 8 steps, 768 square; seeds recorded per item
tail: Single entire object centered, isolated on plain light grey background, soft even studio lighting, three-quarter view from front left and above, little perspective. Brand new, clean. No labels, lettering, logos, scenery, or extra objects.

photo_print.prompt: A warm intimate photographic portrait of a married adult man and woman together, shoulders and heads visible, both about forty years old, a tall dark-haired man and a woman with short auburn hair, simple charcoal and muted olive crew shirts without insignia. They lean together affectionately, relaxed genuine smiles, natural faces. Soft warm light and an unfocused neutral background. Landscape photograph, two people only, no lettering, no borders.

selected_edit.reason: Initial hero showed one man. Edit replaces it with the reviewed couple print and adds a clear-cover reflection.

items.prompt: A small standing landscape photograph frame for a military spacecraft officer's bedside. Narrow satin grey-green steel metal frame, clear glass cover over a warm portrait photograph of one adult man and one adult woman together. A discreet rear folding steel easel supports the upright slightly tilted frame. Industrial restrained keepsake, thin mitred metal rails and small corner screws.

One simple off-white ceramic coffee mug for a military spacecraft dining table. Thick round hollow cup, visible open mouth and interior floor, gently tapered body with rounded foot, a single rounded C-shaped handle on the right. A thin dark olive glaze stripe around the outer rim. Plain practical tableware.

One simple off-white ceramic dinner plate for a military spacecraft dining table. Shallow dished round centre, wide gently rising rim, rounded outer lip, subtle thin dark olive glaze ring near rim, low circular foot underneath. Plain practical tableware.

One compact rugged handheld data tablet lying flat on a table, a military spacecraft personal device. Rounded rectangular muted olive hard-plastic shell, thin dark bezel surrounding a large unlit black glass screen, four small recessed corner fasteners and one small round side button. Practical thin solid device, screen completely dark.

One small open hinged military medal presentation case. Square dark green lacquered steel box with lid held open upright at the rear, brass hinges and a small front clasp. Burgundy inset lining holds one round gold brass service medal with a raised five-point star and short folded muted red and ivory ribbon above it. Restrained spacecraft officer's keepsake.

One small closed personal jewellery box on a spacecraft bedside. Low rounded rectangular ivory hard-plastic body with an inset muted blue lid, thin brass rim around lid, discreet brass hinge along back and small brass front clasp. Restrained retro-future personal keepsake, no decoration or text.

One hairbrush lying flat with bristles upward on a spacecraft bedside. Oval dark olive hard-plastic head with a narrower long smoothly shaped handle, dark rubber inset pad, dense short tan natural bristles in evenly spaced small tufts. Practical personal grooming brush.

A matched pair of tall black-brown leather military officer's boots standing side by side, toes pointing toward camera. Plain round toes, ankle-height creases, calf-high structured shafts with visible dark hollow openings, thick separate black rubber soles, low block heels and narrow leather pull tabs. Smooth polished leather and restrained stitching, traditional pull-on military boots without laces.
